---
name: Feature request
about: Discuss a substantial change before a pull request
labels: enhancement

# Feature request

## Proposal

What user problem should ryl solve?

## Research

Link related open or closed issues, pull requests, and
[design decisions](https://github.com/owenlamont/ryl/blob/main/docs/design/decisions.md)
you checked. Explain how the proposal fits
[ryl's scope](https://github.com/owenlamont/ryl/blob/main/docs/scope.md).

## Precedent

How do the tools ryl models itself on handle this? Cite what you found in
[ruff](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff), [rumdl](https://github.com/rvben/rumdl),
[ty](https://github.com/astral-sh/ty) and [Biome](https://github.com/biomejs/biome),
and in [yamllint](https://github.com/adrienverge/yamllint) where migrating users
are affected. Tested behaviour beats documentation; say which you ran.

## Related issue

Link an existing issue if the proposal builds on one.
